search_text: published ZDI-06-027 ZDI-CAN-066 Microsoft Internet Explorer CSS Class Ordering Memory Corruption Vulnerability 2006-08-08 CVE-2006-3450 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2006-3450 ['Microsoft'] ['Internet Explorer'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific vulnerability exists due to improper handling of CSS class values. Accessing a specially crafted CSS element via document.getElementByID causes a memory corruption eventually leading to code execution. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Microsoft Internet Explorer CSS Class Ordering Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific vulnerability exists due to improper handling of CSS class values. Accessing a specially crafted CSS element via document.getElementByID causes a memory corruption eventually leading to code execution.
